text:
Predicates:
LongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
Favorite(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
Season(x) ::: x is a season.
Premises:
∀x (LongVacation(x) → Favorite(x, summer)) ::: All students who want to have a long vacation love summer the most.
Favorite(emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
¬(Favorite(mia, summer)) ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.
LongVacation(james) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.
Conclusion:
Favorite(james, summer) ::: James's favorite season is summer.
